_about: Public-domain John Eadie (1810-1876, United Presbyterian professor of biblical literature, Glasgow) for the Word Hoard: his commentaries on the Greek text of Ephesians (Edinburgh: T. and T. Clark, 1883) and Galatians (1869), raw Internet Archive OCR. Added 2026-10-03 by lane A, round 10 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. No uids minted. Greek in the text layers (2026-10-03): Galatians 44,340 Greek characters; Ephesians none, and neither other pre-1930 Ephesians copy on IA (Princeton 1861, Toronto 1883) has any.

eadie-ephesians-1883: A Commentary on the Greek Text of the Epistle of Paul to the Ephesians (Edinburgh: T. and T. Clark, 1883)
eadie-galatians-1869: Commentary on the Greek Text of the Epistle of Paul to the Galatians (Edinburgh: T. and T. Clark, 1869)

_alternates.eadie: Colossians (1856) and Ephesians (1861) survive only as microfilm stubs here; the 1883 Ephesians from James and Klock is a later reprint, avoided; Philippians: no pre-1930 scan found yet

_excluded.eadie-philippians-1894: bwb_P7-CIV-298: catalogued 1894 (T. and T. Clark), but by its own front matter a 1977 Klock and Klock reprint; the date gate passed it. Not shelved.

_pending.eadie-thessalonians-1877: greektexte00eadiuoft (A Commentary on the Greek Text of the Epistles of Paul to the Thessalonians (London: Macmillan, 1877)): archive.org returned HTTP 500 on every try, 2026-10-03; retry later. The other copy (commentaryongree0000john) is unchecked.
